lat: zdt shwiya dyal s-sokkar f l-atay
en: I added a little sugar to the tea.
I didn't add salt to the dinner.
You added water to the soup.
You didn't add tomatoes to the salad.
You (f.) added oil to the tagine.
You (f.) didn't add my name to the list.
He raised the price of bread.
He didn't gain a kilo in weight.
She added honey to the milk.
She didn't add yeast to the dough.
We added a new room to the house.
We didn't add money in the bank.
You (pl.) added another chair to the table.
You (pl.) didn't add milk to the coffee.
They raised the workers' pay.
They didn't add chairs to the classroom.
I add cumin to the meat.
I don't add a lot of oil.
You add mint to the tea.
You don't add water to the juice.
You (f.) add chickpeas to the harira.
You (f.) don't add pepper to the salad.

lat: kayzid kul nhar kelma jdida f l-kunnash
ar: كيزيد كل نهار كلمة جديدة فالكناش
en: He adds a new word to his notebook every day.
He doesn't add sugar to the coffee.
She adds oil to the dough.
She doesn't raise the price for her friends.
We add almonds to the sweets.
We don't add water to the milk.
You (pl.) add fruit to the juice.
You (pl.) don't add water to the harira.
They add new books to the library.
They don't add anything to the menu.
I'm going to add water to the pot.
I'm not going to raise the price.

lat: ghadi tzid f l-wazn ila klit bzaf
ar: غادي تزيد فالوزن إلا كليت بزاف
en: You're going to gain weight if you eat a lot.

lat: ma ghadish tzid ta 7aja f l-7sab
ar: ما غاديش تزيد تا حاجة فالحساب
en: You're not going to add anything to the bill.
You (f.) are going to add cinnamon to the coffee.

lat: ma ghadish tzidi l-bsel f l-bissara
en: You (f.) are not going to add onion to the bissara.

ar: غادي يزيد عشرة دراهم على التمن
en: He's going to add ten dirhams to the price.

lat: ma ghadish yzid kelma f r-risala
en: He's not going to add a word to the message.
She's going to add eggs to the cake.

lat: ma ghadish tzid t-twabel f l-wasfa
en: She's not going to add spices to the recipe.

lat: ghadi nzidu kilu dyal d-dqiq f l-3ajin
ar: غادي نزيدو كيلو ديال الدقيق فالعجين
en: We're going to add a kilo of flour to the dough.

lat: ma ghadish nzidu ta 7ed f l-ferqa
ar: ما غاديش نزيدو تا حد فالفرقة
en: We're not going to add anyone to the team.

lat: ghadi tzidu smiyat jdad f l-lista
en: You (pl.) are going to add new names to the list.

lat: ma ghadish tzidu l-fakya f l-kik
en: You (pl.) are not going to add fruit to the cake.

lat: ghadi yzidu tabaq jdid f l-3imara
en: They're going to add a new floor to the building.

lat: ma ghadish yzidu l-wqt f l-imti7an
en: They're not going to add time to the exam.
